summary.text: Michelle Lafleur is the Democratic candidate for the Oklahoma House of Representatives, District 68, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Mike Lay (R).

paragraphs.text: Michelle Lafleur earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Tulsa.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she was born in Tulsa, grew up in Bixby and Tulsa, studied business administration, and worked for Oil and Gas companies in Tulsa, rising to senior landman.
She said she and her husband have spent 15 years raising their family in District 68, with a child in public school.
Lafleur said her first campaign goal is more equitable representation for District 68, which she tied to breaking the Republican supermajority in the Oklahoma House.
She also named housing affordability as a priority.
